messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1 follow-up after the token validation outage. Need clear owners for rotation, perms cleanup, audit-log gap and recurring checks.
Ethan: I can own token rotation. Plan: rotate critical service tokens first (deploy, scheduler, auto-runner). Critical rotated in 48h, full sweep in 7 days.
Noah: I'll take permissions audit. Plan: dump IAM + k8s rolebindings, produce a diff vs baseline, open PR with remediations. ETA 5 business days.
Sofia: Investigating missing audit events for token endpoints. Hypothesis: forwarder filter + consumer lag. Enabling verbose sampling for 24h and will replay traces. ETA ~24h for root cause + mitigation.
Lina (infra): If verbose logging is on, watch filebeat disk and S3 rate. I'll add an autoscale rule and a 12h alert at 80% disk.
sec-bot: Created SEC-820: "token-validation follow-up" assigned to Priya. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-820
Priya: Added a short validation snippet to SEC-820: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEW" https://auth.redwood.internal/introspect | jq .active` 1 expect true for new tokens, false/401 for old.
Ethan: Posted rotation checklist to SEC-820 comments (staging smoke, deploy update, revoke old token).
Noah: I'll snapshot current IAM as baseline and add monthly diff job; auto-open tickets if >5% deviation.
Sofia: I'll paste log samples and the quick mitigation (temporary forwarder override) into SEC-820 when ready.
Priya: Action summary: Ethan -> rotation (48h) + weekly smoke job; Noah -> perms audit + baseline (5d); Sofia -> logs root cause + mitigation (24h); Lina -> infra safety + alerts (now). Review meeting scheduled in 3 business days.
ops-bot: Reminder: review SEC-820 in 3 business days. Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Noah, Sofia, Lina.
